site.description: I'm Mwebesa Brian, the software developer behind SaBrian Digital Solutions. I build websites, custom software and business systems for organisations across Uganda.
site.name: Mwebesa Brian

hero.body: I am the software developer behind SaBrian Digital Solutions. I help businesses build the digital tools they need to grow, without the overhead of a large agency.

philosophy.titleLine2: Make your systems work for you.
philosophy.intro: If you need custom software, you usually have two choices...
philosophy.agencyBody: Big agencies are usually reliable and skilled, but expensive. You pay for their office, their account managers, and their overheads. You rarely speak to the person writing your code.
philosophy.freelancerBody: Freelancers are usually cheaper, but sometimes unreliable. They might vanish halfway through a project or write code that breaks as soon as you scale.
philosophy.quoteTitle: I built SaBrian Digital Solutions to be the middle ground.
philosophy.quoteBody: I offer the technical discipline and architectural knowledge of a senior agency developer, but with the agility and direct communication of a freelancer. You work directly with me. No account managers and no lost in translation. You get direct access to the engineer solving your problem.
philosophy.imageAlt: SaBrian Digital Solutions — websites, custom software and business systems

experience.title: My Experience
experience.bodyPrefix: I build websites, dashboards and business systems for organisations across Uganda — from healthcare and community services to retail and lending. My background is in full-stack

items.title: Enterprise-Level Discipline
items.body: Whether I'm writing React for a user interface, TypeScript for business logic, or configuring Supabase and PostgreSQL, I build systems designed to last. I focus on clean architecture that scales with your business.

items.title: Healthcare Websites
items.body: Built the public site for Bwindi Community Hospital in Kanungu, bringing services, departments, news and appointment forms into one place.

items.title: Business Systems
items.body: Designed loan-management and hardware-store systems for Ugandan organisations, covering applicants, inventory, checkout, accounts and reporting.

location.title: Software developer in Western Uganda
body: I work with organisations across Uganda and remotely with clients further afield. Being based in Butogota keeps me close to the people and projects I build for.
I am always happy to meet for a coffee to sketch out ideas or review a project scope.

contact.title: Let's Chat
contact.subhead: Need a website, custom system or digital partner?
contact.note: I'm always happy to answer questions and share more about how I can help.
